## Summary

Describe the problem and the change in one or two paragraphs.

## Design and security impact

Explain the boundary affected, input validation, deterministic behavior, and whether the no-execution/no-network guarantee changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make format`
- [ ] `make typecheck`
- [ ] `make audit`
- [ ] `make build`

## Documentation

- [ ] README or docs updated when behavior or public contracts changed.
- [ ] Changelog entry added for user-visible behavior.
